title: Foldable paper OpenStreetMap pocket map
blurb: Real OpenStreetMap tiles and four live interactive HTML place pins plus a legend card drawn together on one 2D canvas. Fold the map into four vertical concertina panels and across a horizontal midline crease like a paper pocket map, or unfold it flat to click pins, filter stops, and pan the map.
question: Can real OpenStreetMap tiles and live interactive HTML place pins fold together along vertical and horizontal Ordnance-Survey-style accordion creases on a 2D canvas while staying clickable when unfolded?
result: Not verified in a live browser yet. The page composites live OpenStreetMap tiles with procedural fallback tiles onto an offscreen canvas, slices both the tiles and five sibling drawable HTML cards across a 4x2 hinged paper grid with nine-argument drawElementImage(), and switches to unclipped five-argument draws when flat.
